gloss: soy sauce grilling; grilled with soy sauce

definitions.gloss: soy sauce grilling; grilled with soy sauce
definitions.explanation: A cooking method where ingredients are grilled or pan-fried with soy sauce as the primary seasoning. Also refers to dishes prepared this way. The soy sauce caramelizes during cooking, creating a savory, slightly sweet glaze.

examples.japanese: {餅|もち}の{醤油焼|しょうゆや}きが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like mochi grilled with soy sauce.

examples.japanese: {鶏肉|とりにく}を{醤油焼|しょうゆや}きにして{弁当|べんとう}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I grilled chicken with soy sauce and put it in my lunch box.

examples.japanese: {秋刀魚|さんま}の{醤油焼|しょうゆや}きは、{香|かお}ばしい{匂|にお}いが{食欲|しょくよく}をそそる。
examples.english: The savory aroma of soy sauce-grilled sanma whets the appetite.

notes:
Composed of {醤油|しょうゆ} (soy sauce) and {焼|や}き (grilling, frying). One of the most basic and common Japanese cooking methods, found in home cooking, bento preparation, and restaurant menus.

The method is simple: brush or pour soy sauce over the ingredient during grilling or pan-frying. The heat causes the soy sauce to caramelize, producing the characteristic aromatic glaze. Sometimes {味醂|みりん} (mirin) or {砂糖|さとう} (sugar) is added for sweetness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {醤油焼|しょうゆや}きにする: to grill with soy sauce
- {餅|もち}の{醤油焼|しょうゆや}き: mochi grilled with soy sauce
- {魚|さかな}の{醤油焼|しょうゆや}き: fish grilled with soy sauce
- {鶏|とり}の{醤油焼|しょうゆや}き: chicken grilled with soy sauce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {塩焼|しおや}き: salt grilling — grilling seasoned with salt instead of soy sauce; the most basic grilling method for fish
- {照|て}り{焼|や}き: teriyaki — soy sauce-based glaze with mirin and sugar, producing a thicker, shinier coating than plain {醤油焼|しょうゆや}き
- {味噌焼|みそや}き: miso grilling — grilling with miso paste as the seasoning
- {素焼|すや}き: plain grilling — grilling without any seasoning
